params.caption: A lighthearted and playful French chanson track driven by an intricate nylon-string acoustic guitar performance. The arrangement features a lively, flamenco-influenced guitar playing both rhythmic chords and melodic fills, accompanied by a warm, walking upright bass line and subtle hand percussion that provides a gentle, swinging groove. The lead male vocal is clear and expressive, delivered in a conversational and charming style. The song follows a classic verse-chorus structure, with catchy, melodic choruses and two short, skillful guitar-led instrumental breaks.
